caption: This tonkotsu ramen features a rich, cloudy broth with tender chashu pork and crisp menma arranged atop noodles. Served in a white bowl with red checkered trim, it rests on a tray under warm, natural light.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain pattern with smooth texture and subtle natural wood finish.
The chashu pork is browned, tender-looking, round, with visible fat marbling and a slightly glistening surface.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy, pale yellow, and glossy, swirling around noodles and toppings.
Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, glossy, and slightly curled with visible fibrous texture and translucent sheen.
White ceramic ramen bowl with red checkered pattern and partial "Sakuya" text on its rim.
A metallic spoon with a smooth, slightly reflective surface and a curved, tapered shape.
